name: outw_p
synopsis: void outw_p(unsigned short value, unsigned short port);
description: outw_p performs a 16-bit word output to the specified port and pauses until the I/O operation completes. It is designed for low-level hardware access and is primarily intended for internal kernel use, but can be used in user space with proper permissions.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The 16-bit value to write to the port.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port address to write to.

return_value.failure: May result in a segmentation fault if I/O permissions are not set

bugs: Requires compilation with optimization flags like -O or -O2, as the functions are defined as inline macros and may cause unresolved references without optimization. The functions are hardware-specific and may behave differently across systems.
